I fixed it, though I couldn't run it: nothing here has been tried in a browser yet.

**Cause:** in the Typical state dictation is set up, so the microphone's speech-model menu shows. Its "Remove the model" button had its own `<form>`, and that form sat inside the message box's form. Browsers don't allow one form inside another: they ignore the inner `<form>` tag but act on its closing tag, so the message box's form ended early. Everything after it, including the Send button and the small script that handles Enter, ended up outside the form. The script couldn't find the message box, so Enter just added a new line. The Send button should have been broken too, since a submit button outside a form does nothing.

**Fix:** in `server/views/_dictation.eta`, "Remove the model" and the Cancel shown while the model downloads are now Koda `ko-form` parts. That's how Attach and the saved draft already post from inside the message box, so the message box's form stays whole. The buttons, fields, addresses and targets are the same as before, and no style targets those elements as forms, so they should look the same. I added a comment there saying why they can't be forms.

**What to try:**
- On the Typical state, check that Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a new line, and clicking Send sends.
- With dictation set up, check that "Remove the model" still removes it.
- While a model downloads, check that Cancel still stops it.
- The Building, Popped out and New session states have the microphone set up or downloading too, so check Enter there as well.

Enter to send was very likely never broken in the composer itself. In the design preview, none of the page's scripts were running at all. This explains why my last fix (which was a real bug) didn't change anything you could see. I couldn't run anything to confirm this.

**Why:** the preview renders the app's own layout, which loads Koda from `/koda/koda.js`. `prelude/prelude.json` maps that address to `node_modules/@kodalang/core/src/` in the repository the preview is served from, which here is this design's worktree. A worktree has only committed files, and there's no `node_modules` in it (I checked), so Koda fails to load and never starts. Without Koda, none of the page's `type="koda"` scripts run, so Enter just types a new line. Anything else in the preview that relies on Koda, like menus that load into a region, falls back to plain browser behaviour or nothing.

**Fix (`server/host.js`):** when an app's asset folder isn't in a design's worktree, the design host now serves it from the repository the worktree is a branch of, where `node_modules` is installed. Prelude's own pages were never affected; they load Koda from Prelude's own install.

**When you'll see it:**
- This change is to Prelude's server, and the Prelude you're running is your main checkout. So the preview won't pick it up until this branch is merged and Prelude restarts.
- To check it in the preview now, run `npm install` in the worktree (`C:\Users\JohnHowes\.prelude\worktrees\258e60949d\prelude-design-workspace`), then reload the preview. Koda will then load from the worktree itself, and Enter should send.

The `_dictation.eta` change from last time is still needed. With Koda running, the form nested inside the composer would have stopped Enter and Send working in the Typical state, in the app as well as the preview.
